tools.name: get_snippet
tools.description: Get the full JavaScript code for a specific web performance snippet by its ID.

id.description: Snippet ID (e.g. "LCP", "CLS", "TTFB", "INP"). Use list_snippets to discover available IDs.

tools.name: list_snippets
tools.description: List all web performance measurement snippets available on this site. Returns metadata without code.

tools.name: search_snippets
tools.description: Search web performance snippets by category and/or keyword. Returns metadata without code.

category.description: Filter by category. One of: CoreWebVitals, Loading, Interaction, Media, Resources.

query.description: Keyword to filter by title or description.
